prompt: My project's settings system is currently a bunch of individual JSON files under config/ (one per environment: dev.json, staging.json, prod.json). I want to consolidate them into a single TOML file with environment sections. Need migration for existing settings, one-release backwards-compat (read old JSONs if present, log deprecation warning), and a CLI flag to dump the merged config. Plan this. Solo.
assertions: Plan has explicit Scope IN and Scope OUT lists
Implementer steps include rationale where needed (because/since/so that)
Plan has Checkpoint or verification markers per step
Plan does NOT include a Meta / prompt-template section
Plan uses sub-lists for multi-part thoughts (>=5 nested bullets)
No multi-sentence prose paragraphs longer than 200 chars
Plan does NOT include 'Why not [alternative]' subsection in Approach
Plan does NOT include 'Why this matters for the goal' tag on per-change subsections
Implementer section contains at least one inline code block
